label: ESTIMATE
mechanism: published leaderboard scores are linear measurements of the hidden truth field under DTI = TP/(0.2D+0.8N); invert them on a 300 m presence design and emit one dot per block while expected credit > 0.2*DTI

n_bound.statement: TP is monotone in the dot set (credit is a max over dots), so for a rater pair with containment >= 98% and s_big < s_small: 0 <= 0.2(D_big s_big - D_small s_small) + 0.8 N (s_big - s_small), hence N <= 0.2(D_big s_big - D_small s_small) / (0.8 (s_small - s_big)). Exact under the official metric and the OWNER-REPORT scores; makes no assumption about where the faults are.

caveats: All 128 input scores are OWNER-REPORT values typed by the owner; no organizer receipt exists.
u_b is a shrunken ridge coefficient (credit per dot), not a probability.
The corpus is redundant: the top published rasters share 0.87-1.00 of their dots, so this file redistributes published recall rather than creating new recall.
The estimate is in-sample for the field; the LOO error and the calibration slope are the honest error bar.
Calibration rasters (13GEMSDOE lattice family) saturate the footprint and are not submissions; they are reported, not used as the binding constraint.
